forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: No problem. Enter the email you signed up with and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If an account exists for this address, we sent a link. It works for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder.

forgot.resendWait: You can send it again in {seconds} s
forgot.rateLimited: That is a lot of tries for now. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
forgot.rateLimitedNoWait: That is a lot of tries for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
forgot.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
forgot.generic: We could not send the link right now. Try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: We will help you directly
unavailable.body: Contact the Numerix team and we will give you a reset link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Pick something you will remember, at least {min} characters.

errors.short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
errors.long: The password can have 128 characters at most.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.policy: This password is not accepted. Use between 10 and 128 characters.
errors.rateLimited: That is a lot of tries for now. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.rateLimitedNoWait: That is a lot of tries for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: We could not save your password right now. Try again in a moment.

invalid.title: This link does not work anymore
invalid.body: It may have expired or already been used. A link works once, for a short time. Ask for a new one, it takes a few seconds.

success.title: Password changed
success.body: You can now sign in with your new password.
